text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 148 million markka median
forecast for food, animal feed and chemicals group Raisio Oy's
full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Operating profit after credit losses EPS
(FIM million) (markka)
Median 148 5.60
Lowest 128 5.10
Highest 204 7.80
(Profit forecasts by 13 analysts, EPS by 11 analysts).
Raisio's results are due on February 13.
In 1995, Raisio had a 141 million markka profit before
extraordinaries and tax.
For Raisio's full-year 1997 profit, nine of the 13 analysts
polled gave a median forecast of 244 million markka (mean 253
million) in a 215-300 million markka range.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private
Bankers, Aktia Bank, Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli
Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort
Benson Securities, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
